# Databricks

Use `databricks/<model>` with VoltAgent's model router.

## Quick start

```ts
import { Agent } from "@voltagent/core";

const agent = new Agent({
  name: "databricks-agent",
  instructions: "You are a helpful assistant",
  model: "databricks/databricks-claude-haiku-4-5",
});
```

## Environment variables

- `DATABRICKS_HOST`
- `DATABRICKS_TOKEN`

## Provider package

`@ai-sdk/openai-compatible`

This provider uses the OpenAI-compatible adapter.

## Default base URL

`https://${DATABRICKS_HOST}/ai-gateway/mlflow/v1`

You can override the base URL by setting `DATABRICKS_BASE_URL`.

- https://docs.databricks.com/aws/en/machine-learning/foundation-models/
